Recently purchased RE Classic 500 2019 model from them, 1 star only because they had this model and the engine condition was 💯 however, the rest of the service was absolutely PATHETIC!

4. Since Suraj and his team weren't able to fix issues of the bike, out of frustration I took it away and gave it to my trusted Royal Enfield repair shop where the overall repair costed me +13k. Overall, never trust a used vehicle dealer. Even if he says there's no repair required don't blindly trust them, use vehicles always need basic maintenance and repair so be prepared for it.

featured_reviews.name: jainishsar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience with Odessey Bikes

The problem is the Odessey bike itself – absolute third-class quality.

I purchased it for under ₹2 lakhs, and since then I have already spent more than the same amount of ₹2 lakh extra just to keep it running. That’s how unreliable this so-called “electric bike” is.

The biggest issue – during rains it simply shuts down without warning. Imagine being stranded in the middle of the road, then having to lift this heavy elephant of a bike, put it on a porter, and send it back to the dealer because no normal mechanic will even touch it. Unlike petrol bikes, these cannot be repaired anywhere in the market.

Bottom line – you cannot depend on such a bike. One day it will backfire, and if you rely on it for work or business, your entire day or livelihood can come to a standstill.

My honest advice: Do not waste your money on Odessey bikes. They are unreliable, unworthy, and a complete headache to maintain.
